error_signature: 62 new tool lifecycle failures during setup: FLEET UNAVAILABLE / HASH INBOX UNAVAILABLE
cause: The broad no-egress job starts pytest as root. Both tools intentionally refuse privileged private workspaces. Their separate non-root namespace jobs passed.
fix: Drop to the checkout owner, with empty supplementary groups, no capabilities and no-new-privileges, after creating the same network namespace. Keep the whole original test set; do not skip or permit root.
